# Combine the occurrence and abundance predictions

```{r}
NewDataCombined <- NewDataOccurrenceTrophicLarvae %>%
  bind_cols(NewDataAbundanceTrophicLarvae %>% 
              dplyr::select(ExpAbundFit = ExpAbundFit,
                     AbundSE  = AbundSE)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Backtransform to natural scales
    #OccurrenceProb   = plogis(OccurrenceFit), # probability of occurrence
    #ExpAbundFit  = exp(AbundFit), # predicted abundance when present
    
    # Probability of occurrence * predicted abundance when present = predicted abundance ???
    PredictedAbundanceAccountingForOccurrenceProbability = OccurrenceProb * ExpAbundFit,
    
    # Delta method for SE of product on natural scale
    PredictedAbundanceSE = sqrt(
      (ExpAbundFit^2) * (OccurrenceProb * (1 - OccurrenceProb))^2 * (OccurrenceSE^2) +  # variance of plogis(fit_link)
      (OccurrenceProb^2) * (ExpAbundFit^2) * (AbundSE^2)                      # variance of exp(fit_abund)
    ),
    
    # 95% confidence intervals
    PredictedAbundanceLwr = PredictedAbundanceAccountingForOccurrenceProbability - 1.96 * PredictedAbundanceSE,
    PredictedAbundanceUpr = PredictedAbundanceAccountingForOccurrenceProbability + 1.96 * PredictedAbundanceSE
  )
  

# Plot
FinalPlotAbundanceOccurrenceLarvaeTLCombined <- ggplot(NewDataCombined,
       aes(x = UnscaledAvgTrophicLevel, y = PredictedAbundanceAccountingForOccurrenceProbability,
           color = LandUseFinal, fill = LandUseFinal)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = PredictedAbundanceLwr, ymax = PredictedAbundanceUpr),
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  labs(x = expression("Larval trophic level"),
       y = "Predicted abundance = a x b (± 95 % CI)",
       color = "Land use") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2,3), labels = c("PC", "SC")) 

#ggsave(filename = "./figures/c4_updated/LarvalTrophicLevelAbundanceOccurrenceCombined.png",  plot = FinalPlotAbundanceOccurrenceLarvaeTLCombined, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# Create new data frame for predictions
NewDataOccurrenceTrophicAdult <- expand.grid(
  ScaledAvgTrophicLevelAdult = seq(from = min(ModelDataAdultDietOccurrence$ScaledAvgTrophicLevelAdult, na.rm = TRUE),
                to   = max(ModelDataAdultDietOccurrence$ScaledAvgTrophicLevelAdult, na.rm = TRUE),
                length.out = 100),
  LandUseFinal = levels(ModelDataAdultDietOccurrence$LandUseFinal))

# Copy the factor levels from the model data

                              levels = levels(ModelDataAdultDietOccurrence$LandUseFinal))

# Predicted probabilities on link scale (logit) with SE
OccurrencePredictions <- predict(oc_m1, newdata = NewDataOccurrenceTrophicAdult, type = "link", se.fit = TRUE, re.form = NA)

# Add predictions into data frame
NewDataOccurrenceTrophicAdult <- NewDataOccurrenceTrophicAdult %>%
  mutate(
    OccurrenceFit   = OccurrencePredictions$fit,
    OccurrenceSE    = OccurrencePredictions$se.fit,
    OccurrenceLwr = OccurrenceFit - 1.96 * OccurrenceSE,
    OccurrenceUpr = OccurrenceFit + 1.96 * OccurrenceSE,
    # Back-transform to probability scale
    OccurrenceProb   = plogis(OccurrenceFit), # predicted probability - plogis() is the inverse of the logit function.
    # It takes values on the logit (link) scale (from −∞ to +∞) and transforms them into probabilities between 0 and 1.
    LowerProb = plogis(OccurrenceLwr), # 95% CI lower bound
    UpperProb = plogis(OccurrenceUpr) # 95% CI upper bound
  )

# Extract coefficient in primary
fixef(oc_m1)["ScaledAvgTrophicLevelAdult"]

# Significance of body mass effect in primary
bayestestR::convert_pd_to_p(parameters::p_value(oc_m1, method = "eti"))

# Extract mass x land use F ratio
anova(oc_m1)
Anova(oc_m1)

# Extract the mean and sd to add the unscaled values back into the prediction data frame for plotting
mean_val <- attr(ModelDataAdultDietOccurrence$ScaledAvgTrophicLevelAdult, "scaled:center")
sd_val   <- attr(ModelDataAdultDietOccurrence$ScaledAvgTrophicLevelAdult, "scaled:scale")

# Add a new column with the back transformed values:
NewDataOccurrenceTrophicAdult$UnscaledAvgTrophicLevelAdult <- NewDataOccurrenceTrophicAdult$ScaledAvgTrophicLevelAdult * sd_val + mean_val

# Plot
PlotOccurrenceTrophicAdult <- ggplot(NewDataOccurrenceTrophicAdult, aes(x = UnscaledAvgTrophicLevelAdult, y = OccurrenceProb, color = LandUseFinal, fill = LandUseFinal)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = LowerProb, ymax = UpperProb, fill = LandUseFinal), 
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  labs(x = expression("Adult trophic level"),
       y = "Probability of occurrence (± 95 % CI)",
       color = "Land use") +
  guides(fill = "none") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2,3), labels = c("Primary consumer", "Secondary consumer"))

PlotOccurrenceTrophicAdultNoLegend <- PlotOccurrenceTrophicAdult + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2,3), labels = c("PC", "SC"))


FinalPlotOccurrenceTrophicAdultNoLegend <- ggdraw(PlotOccurrenceTrophicAdultNoLegend) +
  draw_label("Coefficient in primary: 
   -0.07 [95% CI: -0.10, -0.05], p < 0.001
              Adult TL x LU interaction: 
  F-ratio = 71.46, p < 0.0001", x = 0.96, y = 0.96, hjust = 0.9, vjust = 0.9, size = 10)

FinalPlotOccurrenceTrophicAdult <- ggdraw(PlotOccurrenceTrophicAdult) +
```

# Create the combined plot 

```{r}
NewDataCombined <- NewDataOccurrenceTrophicAdult %>%
  bind_cols(NewDataAbundanceTrophicAdult %>% 
              dplyr::select(ExpAbundFit = ExpAbundFit,
                     AbundSE  = AbundSE)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Probability of occurrence * predicted abundance when present = predicted abundance ???
    PredictedAbundanceAccountingForOccurrenceProbability = OccurrenceProb * ExpAbundFit,
    
    # Delta method for SE of product on natural scale
    PredictedAbundanceSE = sqrt(
      (ExpAbundFit^2) * (OccurrenceProb * (1 - OccurrenceProb))^2 * (OccurrenceSE^2) +  # variance of plogis(fit_link)
      (OccurrenceProb^2) * (ExpAbundFit^2) * (AbundSE^2)                      # variance of exp(fit_abund)
    ),
    
    # 95% confidence intervals
    PredictedAbundanceLwr = PredictedAbundanceAccountingForOccurrenceProbability - 1.96 * PredictedAbundanceSE,
    PredictedAbundanceUpr = PredictedAbundanceAccountingForOccurrenceProbability + 1.96 * PredictedAbundanceSE
  )

# Plot
FinalPlotAbundanceOccurrenceMassCombined <- ggplot(NewDataCombined,
       aes(x = UnscaledAvgTrophicLevelAdult, y = PredictedAbundanceAccountingForOccurrenceProbability,
           color = LandUseFinal, fill = LandUseFinal)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = PredictedAbundanceLwr, ymax = PredictedAbundanceUpr),
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  labs(x = expression("Adult trophic level"),
       y = "Predicted abundance = a x b (± 95 % CI)",
       color = "Land use") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2,3), labels = c("PC", "SC")) 
#ggsave(filename = "./figures/c4_updated/AdultTrophicLevelAbundanceOccurrenceCombined.png",  plot = FinalPlotAbundanceOccurrenceMassCombined, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

# Calculate average dispersal ability and merge with PREDICTS

```{r}
# Select cols of interest   
dispersal <- traits %>% dplyr::select(c(1:8, 196:200))

# define dispersal columns
dispersal_cols <- c("Dispersal ability | Very low",
                    "Dispersal ability | Low",
                    "Dispersal ability | Medium",
                    "Dispersal ability | High",
                    "Dispersal ability | Very high")

# filter rows with dispersal data
dispersal <- dispersal %>%
  filter(if_any(all_of(dispersal_cols), ~ !is.na(.) & . > 0)) # if any dispersal columns is not NA and the value is greater than 0 - keep!

# Set up the ordinal scale for calculating average dispersal ability on a scale of 0 to 4
ordinal_scale <- c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4)

# calculate average dispersal ability
AverageDispersalFamily <- dispersal %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    avg_dispersal = sum(as.numeric(c_across(all_of(dispersal_cols))) * ordinal_scale, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(Family, avg_dispersal)
```

# Read in PREDICTS data and ensure that species level entities in the Taxon_name_entered column such as "Lasioglossum sp." are included for merging average trophic level values - this would be at the genus level, since a taxon such as "Lasioglossum sp" could be assigned a genus but we don't know the specific species name. 

```{r}
# All insect data effort-corrected and merged
taxon_insects <-  qread("/Users/jusi/Desktop/multi-groups/data/predicts-prepared-whole-database.qs")

# Get rid of rows which aren't resolved to order level
taxon_insects <- taxon_insects %>% filter(Order != "") # 1056 rows not resolved to order

# Recreate genus and species column as sometimes BGB is present in PREDICTS but no info for genus or sp.
taxon_insects <- taxon_insects %>%
  mutate(Best_guess_binomial = as.character(Best_guess_binomial)) %>%
  separate(Best_guess_binomial, into = c("Genus", "Species"), sep = " ", remove = FALSE, extra = "merge", fill = "right")

# There are entries in PREDICTS such as "Lasioglossum sp" - rows with such names tend to not have an entry in the genus column (due to issues with the COL API)
# Previously these taxa were getting family level values in the average mass analysis, despite their genus information being available.
# I will extract the genus information from the Taxon_name_entered column for those rows that do not yet have an entry in genus.
# This will improve the precision of the matching, such that these rows will now be matched at the genus level instead of the family level (as they were beforehand)
taxon_insects <- taxon_insects %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = case_when(
      is.na(Genus) | Genus == "" ~ word(Taxon_name_entered, 1), # Check if Genus is empty or missing, if so, extract the first word from Taxon_name_entered and assign it to genus column.
      TRUE ~ Genus # If genus is not empty, leave it as the pre-existing genus entry. 
    ))

# Have a look
taxon_insects %>% dplyr::select(SS, SSBS, Order, Family, Genus, Species, Taxon_name_entered, Best_guess_binomial, Precision_score) %>% View()

# Remove those entries which have a "?" before or after the name of the genus e.g. "?Abalabus" or "Abalabus?"
taxon_insects <- taxon_insects %>%
  mutate(Genus = str_remove_all(Genus, "\\?"))

# Remove leading and trailing double quotation marks
taxon_insects <- taxon_insects %>%
  mutate(Genus = str_replace_all(Genus, '^"|"$', ""))

# Remove any numbers 
taxon_insects <- taxon_insects %>%
  mutate(Genus = str_remove_all(Genus, "[0-9]"))

# Remove entries with sp at the end
taxon_insects <- taxon_insects %>%
  mutate(Genus = str_remove(Genus, "(_|\\s)?sp\\.?$"))

# Filter for columns of interest
taxon_insects <- taxon_insects %>% dplyr::select(Source_ID, SS, SSB, SSBS, Order, Family, Genus, Species, Taxon_name_entered, Best_guess_binomial, Diversity_metric, Diversity_metric_unit, Merged_diversity, Predominant_habitat, Use_intensity)
```

# Now that I have an overall data frame for average dispersal ability for all insect taxa in PREDICTS, I will now filter it for species level entities using APs taxon resolution file and then prepare the data frame for analysis.

```{r}
# Filter for diversity metrics of interest - abundance and occurrence data can be used (i.e. no species richness data)
AllInsectsDispersal <- AllInsectsDispersal %>% filter(Diversity_metric %in% c("abundance", "effort-corrected abundance", "density", "group abundance", "occurrence", "occurrence frequency", "relative abundance"))

# Load taxon resolution file
TaxonResolution <- readRDS(here("data", "CuratedTaxonResolution2.rds"))

# Step 1: Filter TaxonResolution for species-level entries - i.e. those entries with a precision score of 4!
TaxonResolutionSp <- TaxonResolution %>%
  filter(PrecisionScore == 4) %>%
  dplyr::select(SS, Taxon_name_entered) # select cols for merging

# Step 2: Keep only matching rows in AllInsectsDispersal
AllInsectsDispersalSpeciesOnly <- AllInsectsDispersal %>%
  semi_join(TaxonResolutionSp, by = c("SS", "Taxon_name_entered")) # keeps only rows in AllInsectsDispersal that have a match in TaxonResolutionSp. based on SS and Taxon_name_entered

# AllInsectsDispersalSpeciesOnly now contains only the rows from AllInsectsDispersal that correspond to species-level entries in TaxonResolutionSp. 

# Create a present or absent column - its present if Merged_diversity > 0 and absent if its 0
AllInsectsDispersalSpeciesOnly <- AllInsectsDispersalSpeciesOnly %>%
  mutate(PresentOrAbsent = ifelse(Merged_diversity > 0, 1, 0))

# Create a log(abundance when present) column
AllInsectsDispersalSpeciesOnly <- AllInsectsDispersalSpeciesOnly %>% 
  mutate(
    LogAbundanceWhenPresent = ifelse(Merged_diversity > 0,
                                    log(Merged_diversity),
                                    NA))

# Have a look at how many rows are present versus absent
table(AllInsectsDispersalSpeciesOnly$PresentOrAbsent)

# Rename predominant habitat since its not really habitat we're looking at
AllInsectsDispersalSpeciesOnly <- rename(AllInsectsDispersalSpeciesOnly,
                Predominant_land_use = Predominant_habitat)

# Relevel the land use and use intensity classes
AllInsectsDispersalSpeciesOnly <- AllInsectsDispersalSpeciesOnly %>%
  mutate(
    # collapse primary forest and non-forest together into primary vegetation as these aren't well distinguished
    Predominant_land_use = recode_factor(Predominant_land_use, 
                                         "Primary forest" = "Primary", 
                                         "Primary non-forest" = "Primary"),
    # indeterminate secondary veg and cannot decide get NA
   Predominant_land_use = na_if(Predominant_land_use, "Secondary vegetation (indeterminate age)"),
    Predominant_land_use = na_if(Predominant_land_use, "Cannot decide"), 
    Use_intensity = na_if(Use_intensity, "Cannot decide"),
    
    # set reference levels
    Predominant_land_use = factor(Predominant_land_use),
    Predominant_land_use = relevel(Predominant_land_use, ref = "Primary"),
    Use_intensity = factor(Use_intensity),
    Use_intensity = relevel(Use_intensity, ref = "Minimal use")
  )

table(AllInsectsDispersalSpeciesOnly$Predominant_land_use)
table(AllInsectsDispersalSpeciesOnly$Predominant_land_use, AllInsectsDispersalSpeciesOnly$Use_intensity)
```

# Recode the land use classes to have Primary, Secondary vegetation, Low-intensity agriculture and high-intensity agriculture

```{r}

AllInsectsDispersalSpeciesOnly <- AllInsectsDispersalSpeciesOnly %>%
  mutate(
    LandUseFinal = case_when(
      # Primary stays as is
      Predominant_land_use == "Primary" ~ "Primary",

      # Any secondary vegetation type -> Secondary Vegetation
      Predominant_land_use %in% c("Young secondary vegetation",
                                  "Intermediate secondary vegetation",
                                  "Mature secondary vegetation") ~ "Secondary vegetation",

      # Plantation forest depends on intensity
      Predominant_land_use == "Plantation forest" & Use_intensity == "Minimal use" ~ "Low-intensity agriculture",
      Predominant_land_use == "Plantation forest" & Use_intensity %in% c("Light use", "Intense use") ~ "High-intensity agriculture",

      # Pasture
      Predominant_land_use == "Pasture" & Use_intensity %in% c("Minimal use", "Light use") ~ "Low-intensity agriculture",
      Predominant_land_use == "Pasture" & Use_intensity == "Intense use" ~ "High-intensity agriculture",

      # Cropland
      Predominant_land_use == "Cropland" & Use_intensity %in% c("Minimal use", "Light use") ~ "Low-intensity agriculture",
      Predominant_land_use == "Cropland" & Use_intensity == "Intense use" ~ "High-intensity agriculture",

      # Drop Urban by assigning NA -these will get dropped when we create the model data
      Predominant_land_use == "Urban" ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  # Turn into factor if you want ordered categories
  mutate(LandUseFinal = factor(LandUseFinal,
                               levels = c("Primary", "Secondary vegetation",
                                          "Low-intensity agriculture", "High-intensity agriculture")))

table(AllInsectsDispersalSpeciesOnly$LandUseFinal)
```

# Modelling log(abundance of present species) ~ LUFinal * average dispersal ability

```{r}
# Maximal random effects structure
ab_m1 <- blmer(LogAbundanceWhenPresent ~ LandUseFinal * avg_dispersal + (1 | Source_ID/SS/SSB) + (1| Family/SpeciesFinal), 
               data = ModelDataDispersalAbundance,
                   control = lme4::lmerControl(
                     optimizer = "nloptwrap",
                     optCtrl = list(algorithm = "NLOPT_LN_SBPLX", maxeval = 1e6)))

# Drop block
ab_m2 <- blmer(LogAbundanceWhenPresent ~ LandUseFinal * avg_dispersal + (1 | Source_ID/SS) + (1| Family/SpeciesFinal), 
               data = ModelDataDispersalAbundance,
                   control = lme4::lmerControl(
                     optimizer = "nloptwrap",
                     optCtrl = list(algorithm = "NLOPT_LN_SBPLX", maxeval = 1e6)))

# Drop SS
ab_m3 <- blmer(LogAbundanceWhenPresent ~ LandUseFinal * avg_dispersal + (1 | Source_ID) + (1| Family/SpeciesFinal), 
               data = ModelDataDispersalAbundance,
                   control = lme4::lmerControl(
                     optimizer = "nloptwrap",
                     optCtrl = list(algorithm = "NLOPT_LN_SBPLX", maxeval = 1e6)))

# Drop Family
ab_m4 <- blmer(LogAbundanceWhenPresent ~ LandUseFinal * avg_dispersal + (1 | Source_ID) + (1 | SpeciesFinal), 
               data = ModelDataDispersalAbundance,
                   control = lme4::lmerControl(
                     optimizer = "nloptwrap",
                     optCtrl = list(algorithm = "NLOPT_LN_SBPLX", maxeval = 1e6)))

# Compare models
anova(ab_m1, ab_m2, ab_m3, ab_m4)  # Likelihood ratio test
AIC(ab_m1, ab_m2, ab_m3, ab_m4)


# ab_m1 best!
```

# Backwards stepwise selection of fixed effects

```{r}
# Additive model with the interaction removed but both predictors still present
ab_m5 <- blmer(LogAbundanceWhenPresent ~ LandUseFinal + avg_dispersal + (1 | Source_ID/SS/SSB) + (1| Family/SpeciesFinal), data = ModelDataDispersalAbundance,
                   control = lme4::lmerControl(
                     optimizer = "nloptwrap",
                     optCtrl = list(algorithm = "NLOPT_LN_SBPLX", maxeval = 1e6)))

# Just land use as predictor
ab_m6 <- blmer(LogAbundanceWhenPresent ~ LandUseFinal + (1 | Source_ID/SS/SSB) + (1| Family/SpeciesFinal), data = ModelDataDispersalAbundance,
                   control = lme4::lmerControl(
                     optimizer = "nloptwrap",
                     optCtrl = list(algorithm = "NLOPT_LN_SBPLX", maxeval = 1e6)))

# Just average dispersal level as the predictor
ab_m7 <- blmer(LogAbundanceWhenPresent ~ avg_dispersal + (1 | Source_ID/SS/SSB) + (1| Family/SpeciesFinal), data = ModelDataDispersalAbundance,
                   control = lme4::lmerControl(
                     optimizer = "nloptwrap",
                     optCtrl = list(algorithm = "NLOPT_LN_SBPLX", maxeval = 1e6)))

# Make a null, intercept only model
ab_m8 <- blmer(LogAbundanceWhenPresent ~ (1 | Source_ID/SS/SSB) + (1| Family/SpeciesFinal), data = ModelDataDispersalAbundance,
                   control = lme4::lmerControl(
                     optimizer = "nloptwrap",
                     optCtrl = list(algorithm = "NLOPT_LN_SBPLX", maxeval = 1e6)))


## Compare the models
AIC(ab_m1, ab_m5, ab_m6, ab_m7, ab_m8)
anova(ab_m1, ab_m5, ab_m6, ab_m7, ab_m8)
anova(ab_m6, ab_m1)

# ab_m1 best model
```

```{r}
   oc_m3 = quote(
```

# Generate predictions from the model
 
```{r}
# Interaction more significant than just additive effect 
anova(oc_m4)

# Create new data frame for predictions
NewDataOccurrenceDispersal <- expand.grid(
  ScaledAvgDispersal = seq(from = min(ModelDataDispersalOccurrence$ScaledAvgDispersal, na.rm = TRUE),
                to   = max(ModelDataDispersalOccurrence$ScaledAvgDispersal, na.rm = TRUE),
                length.out = 100),
  LandUseFinal = levels(ModelDataDispersalOccurrence$LandUseFinal))

# Copy the factor levels from the model data
NewDataOccurrenceDispersal$LandUseFinal <- factor(NewDataOccurrenceDispersal$LandUseFinal, 
                              levels = levels(ModelDataDispersalOccurrence$LandUseFinal))

# Predicted probabilities on link scale (logit) with SE
OccurrencePredictions <- predict(oc_m4, newdata = NewDataOccurrenceDispersal, type = "link", se.fit = TRUE, re.form = NA)

# Add predictions into data frame
NewDataOccurrenceDispersal <- NewDataOccurrenceDispersal %>%
  mutate(
    OccurrenceFit   = OccurrencePredictions$fit,
    OccurrenceSE    = OccurrencePredictions$se.fit,
    OccurrenceLwr = OccurrenceFit - 1.96 * OccurrenceSE,
    OccurrenceUpr = OccurrenceFit + 1.96 * OccurrenceSE,
    # Back-transform to probability scale
    OccurrenceProb   = plogis(OccurrenceFit), # predicted probability - plogis() is the inverse of the logit function.
    # It takes values on the logit (link) scale (from −∞ to +∞) and transforms them into probabilities between 0 and 1.
    LowerProb = plogis(OccurrenceLwr), # 95% CI lower bound
    UpperProb = plogis(OccurrenceUpr) # 95% CI upper bound
  )

# Extract coefficient in primary
fixef(oc_m3)["ScaledAvgDispersal"]

# Significance of body mass effect in primary
bayestestR::convert_pd_to_p(parameters::p_value(oc_m3, method = "eti"))

# Extract mass x land use F ratio
anova(oc_m3)
Anova(oc_m3)

# Extract the mean and sd to add the unscaled values back into the prediction data frame for plotting
mean_val <- attr(ModelDataDispersalOccurrence$ScaledAvgDispersal, "scaled:center")
sd_val   <- attr(ModelDataDispersalOccurrence$ScaledAvgDispersal, "scaled:scale")

# Add a new column with the unscaled values:
NewDataOccurrenceDispersal$UnscaledAvgDispersal <- NewDataOccurrenceDispersal$ScaledAvgDispersal * sd_val + mean_val

# Plot
PlotOccurrenceDispersal <- ggplot(NewDataOccurrenceDispersal,
       aes(x = UnscaledAvgDispersal, y = OccurrenceProb,
           color = LandUseFinal, fill = LandUseFinal)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = LowerProb, ymax = UpperProb),
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  labs(x = expression("Dispersal ability"),
       y = "Probability of occurrence (± 95 % CI)",
       color = "Land use") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:4, labels = c("very low", "low", "medium", "high", "very high"))

PlotOccurrenceDispersalNoLegend <- PlotOccurrenceDispersal + theme(legend.position = "none")

FinalPlotOccurrenceDispersalNoLegend <- ggdraw(PlotOccurrenceDispersalNoLegend) +
  draw_label("Coefficient in primary: 
   -0.09 [95% CI: -0.16, -0.03], p = 0.005
              Dispersal ability x LU interaction: 
  F-ratio = 34.98, p < 0.0001", x = 0.96, y = 0.96, hjust = 0.9, vjust = 0.9, size = 10)

FinalPlotOccurrenceDispersal <- ggdraw(PlotOccurrenceDispersal) +
  draw_label("Coefficient in primary: 
   -0.09 [95% CI: -0.16, -0.03], p = 0.005
              Dispersal ability x LU interaction: 
  F-ratio = 34.98, p < 0.0001", x = 0.96, y = 0.96, hjust = 0.9, vjust = 0.9, size = 10)

      #ggsave(filename = "./figures/c4_updated/DispersalAbilityOccurrence.png",  plot = FinalPlotOccurrenceDispersal, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

# Combine the predictions

```{r}
NewDataCombined <- NewDataOccurrenceDispersal %>%
  bind_cols(NewDataAbundanceDispersal %>% 
              dplyr::select(ExpAbundFit = ExpAbundFit,
                     AbundSE  = AbundSE)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Probability of occurrence * predicted abundance when present 
    PredictedAbundanceAccountingForOccurrenceProbability = OccurrenceProb * ExpAbundFit,
    
    # Delta method for SE of product on natural scale
    PredictedAbundanceSE = sqrt(
      (ExpAbundFit^2) * (OccurrenceProb * (1 - OccurrenceProb))^2 * (OccurrenceSE^2) +  # variance of plogis(fit_link)
      (OccurrenceProb^2) * (ExpAbundFit^2) * (AbundSE^2)                      # variance of exp(fit_abund)
    ),
    
    # 95% confidence intervals
    PredictedAbundanceLwr = PredictedAbundanceAccountingForOccurrenceProbability - 1.96 * PredictedAbundanceSE,
    PredictedAbundanceUpr = PredictedAbundanceAccountingForOccurrenceProbability + 1.96 * PredictedAbundanceSE
  )

# Plot
FinalPlotAbundanceOccurrenceDispersalCombined <- ggplot(NewDataCombined,
       aes(x = UnscaledAvgDispersal, y = PredictedAbundanceAccountingForOccurrenceProbability,
           color = LandUseFinal, fill = LandUseFinal)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = PredictedAbundanceLwr, ymax = PredictedAbundanceUpr),
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  labs(x = expression("Dispersal ability"),
       y = "Predicted abundance = a x b (± 95 % CI)",
       color = "Land use") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:4, labels = c("very low", "low", "medium", "high", "very high")) 

#ggsave(filename = "./figures/c4_updated/DispersalAbilityAbundanceOccurrenceCombined.png",  plot = FinalPlotAbundanceOccurrenceDispersalCombined, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

# Merge AllInsectsSize with PREDICTS site level abundance data (don't need to do this as we are calculating SPECIES level abundances not SITE LEVEL)

```{r}
# All-insect set of site-level log(abundance) data
# Has filtered out accidentally sampled larvae
abundance <-  qread("/Users/jusi/Desktop/multi-groups/data/abundance-data-prepared-all-insects.qs")

# Use dplyr to reshape the abundance data
# For each SSBS: sum the total abundance values then take the mean log_plus_what (they'll all be the same - comes from the minimum non-zero value across the entire study) 
# logAllInsectAbundance = log(sumTotalAbundance + mean_log_plus_what) - an overall abundance value for all of the insects at each site!
abundance_summary <- abundance %>%
  group_by(SSBS) %>%
  summarise(
    sumTotalAbundance = sum(Total_abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_log_plus_what = mean(Log_plus_what, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(logAllInsectAbundance = log(sumTotalAbundance + mean_log_plus_what))

# Filter PREDICTS for same set of sites as in my AllInsectsSize dataset
filtered_abundance <-  abundance_summary %>%
  filter(SSBS %in% AllInsectsSize$SSBS) %>%
  distinct(SSBS, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Merge abundance values into the AllInsectsSize data frame 
AllInsectsSize <- AllInsectsSize %>%
  left_join(filtered_abundance %>% dplyr::select(SSBS, logAllInsectAbundance), by = "SSBS")

rm(abundance, abundance_summary, filtered_abundance)
```

# Tidy the model data 

```{r}
# Rename predominant habitat since its not really habitat we're looking at
avg_mass_by_SSBS <- rename(avg_mass_by_SSBS,
                Predominant_land_use = Predominant_habitat)

# Relevel the land use and use intensity classes
avg_mass_by_SSBS <- avg_mass_by_SSBS %>%
  mutate(
    # collapse primary forest and non-forest together into primary vegetation as these aren't well distinguished
    Predominant_land_use = recode_factor(Predominant_land_use, 
                                         "Primary forest" = "Primary", 
                                         "Primary non-forest" = "Primary"),
    # indeterminate secondary veg and cannot decide get NA
   Predominant_land_use = na_if(Predominant_land_use, "Secondary vegetation (indeterminate age)"),
    Predominant_land_use = na_if(Predominant_land_use, "Cannot decide"), 
    Use_intensity = na_if(Use_intensity, "Cannot decide"),
    
    # set reference levels
    Predominant_land_use = factor(Predominant_land_use),
    Predominant_land_use = relevel(Predominant_land_use, ref = "Primary"),
    Use_intensity = factor(Use_intensity),
    Use_intensity = relevel(Use_intensity, ref = "Minimal use")
  )
```

```{r}
# Filter for orders of interest
OrdersWeWant <- traits %>% filter(Order %in% c("Coleoptera", "Diptera", "Hemiptera", "Lepidoptera", "Hymenoptera", "Odonata", "Orthoptera"))

# Identify all traits present for a group
OrdersWeWant %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = 9:ncol(.), # all trait columns
               names_to = "Trait", # new column for trait names
               values_to = "Value") %>%# new column for the values
  filter(!is.na(Value) & Value != 0) %>%  # keep only traits that are present, i.e are not NA or 0
View()

# Pivot longer traits
OrdersPivot <- OrdersWeWant %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = 9:ncol(.), # first 8 cols are meta data
    names_to = "Trait",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value) & Value != "0") %>% # if the trait value is not an NA and is not equal to 0
  separate(Trait, into = c("Trait", "Modality", "Unit"), sep = "\\|", fill = "right", extra = "merge") %>% 
  mutate(Mode = ifelse(is.na(Unit), Modality, paste(Modality, Unit))) %>% # what is the trait category
  dplyr::select(-Modality, -Unit) %>% # remove redundant cols
  dplyr::select(-Value, -Taxon_Code, -SubOrder, -InfraOrder, -SuperFamiy, -`Taxon Name`, -`Approx Species Richness`,  Value)   # moves 'Value' to the end
```

```{r}
# For each model data - filter for the big five
BigFiveModelBodyMassOccurrence <- ModelDataSizeOccurrence %>% filter(Order %in% c("Coleoptera", "Diptera", "Hemiptera", "Hymenoptera", "Lepidoptera"))
BigFiveModelEggVolumeOccurrence <- ModelDataEggOccurrence %>% filter(Order %in% c("Coleoptera", "Diptera", "Hemiptera", "Hymenoptera", "Lepidoptera"))
BigFiveModelAdultDietOccurrence <- ModelDataAdultDietOccurrence %>% filter(Order %in% c("Coleoptera", "Diptera", "Hemiptera", "Hymenoptera", "Lepidoptera"))
BigFiveModelDataLarvalDietOccurrence <- ModelDataLarvalDietOccurrence %>% filter(Order %in% c("Coleoptera", "Diptera", "Hemiptera", "Hymenoptera", "Lepidoptera"))
BigFiveModelDataDispersalOccurrence <- ModelDataDispersalOccurrence %>% filter(Order %in% c("Coleoptera", "Diptera", "Hemiptera", "Hymenoptera", "Lepidoptera"))

# Scale the predictors
BigFiveModelEggVolumeOccurrence$ScaledLogAvgEggVolume_mm3 <- scale(BigFiveModelEggVolumeOccurrence$LogAvgEggVolume_mm3, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

BigFiveModelDataDispersalOccurrence$ScaledAvgDispersal <- scale(BigFiveModelDataDispersalOccurrence$avg_dispersal, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

BigFiveModelDataLarvalDietOccurrence$ScaledAvgTrophicLevel_larval <- scale(BigFiveModelDataLarvalDietOccurrence$AvgTrophicLevel_larval, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

BigFiveModelAdultDietOccurrence$ScaledAvgTrophicLevelAdult <- scale(BigFiveModelAdultDietOccurrence$AvgTrophicLevelAdult, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

BigFiveModelBodyMassOccurrence$ScaledLog10Mass <- scale(BigFiveModelBodyMassOccurrence$log10_mass, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)


# Put model formulas in a list
model_calls <- list(
  EggVolumeOccurrenceModel = quote(
    bglmer(PresentOrAbsent ~ LandUseFinal * ScaledLogAvgEggVolume_mm3 * Order +
             (1 | Source_ID) + (1 | SpeciesFinal),
           data = BigFiveModelEggVolumeOccurrence,
           family = binomial(link = "logit"),
           control = lme4::glmerControl(
             optimizer = "Nelder_Mead",
             optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
           ))
  ),
LarvalDietOccurrenceModel = quote(
    bglmer(PresentOrAbsent ~ LandUseFinal * ScaledAvgTrophicLevel_larval * Order + (1 | SS) + (1| SpeciesFinal), 
               data = BigFiveModelDataLarvalDietOccurrence, family = binomial(link = "logit"),
               control = lme4::glmerControl(
                 optimizer = "Nelder_Mead",
                 optCtrl = list(maxfun = 7e5)
                 ))
  ),
  AdultDietOccurrenceModel = quote(
    bglmer(PresentOrAbsent ~ LandUseFinal * ScaledAvgTrophicLevelAdult * Order + (1 | Source_ID) + (1 | SpeciesFinal), 
               data = BigFiveModelAdultDietOccurrence, family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "nloptwrap",
    optCtrl = list(
      algorithm = "NLOPT_LN_NELDERMEAD",
      maxeval = 1e4)
  ))
),
  DispersalOccurrenceModel = quote(
    bglmer(PresentOrAbsent ~ LandUseFinal * ScaledAvgDispersal * Order + (1 | SS) + (1 | Genus) + (1 | SpeciesFinal), 
               data = BigFiveModelDataDispersalOccurrence, family = binomial(link = "logit"), 
               control = lme4::glmerControl(
                 optimizer = "bobyqa",
                 optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e7)
                 ))
  ),
 BodyMassOccurrenceModel = quote(
   bglmer(PresentOrAbsent ~ LandUseFinal * log10_mass * Order +
             (1 | Source_ID) + (1 | SpeciesFinal),
           data = BigFiveModelBodyMassOccurrence,
           family = binomial(link = "logit"),
           control = lme4::glmerControl(
             optimizer = "bobyqa",
             optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000)
             ))
))



# Run models in parallel
results <- mclapply(model_calls, function(expr) eval(expr),
                    mc.cores = 4)  # adjust cores


results <- mclapply(model_calls, function(expr) {
  try(eval(expr), silent = TRUE)
}, mc.cores = 5)



library(future.apply)

# Use separate R sessions instead of forks
plan(multisession, workers = 5)

results <- future_lapply(model_calls, function(expr) {
  library(blme)
  library(lme4)
  try(eval(expr), silent = TRUE)
})

eval(model_calls[[1]])

oc_m1 <- results[[1]]
oc_m2 <- results[[2]]

summary(oc_m1)
summary(oc_m2)

# Compare models
anova(oc_m1, oc_m2)  # Likelihood ratio test
AIC(oc_m1, oc_m2)
```
